questions.subject: CHINESE
questions.topic: What a vacancy notice selects for attention

stimulus.body: 材料背景：A notice in the brief stresses fast-paced environment and tight deadlines repeatedly. 「The role demands high time management.」 请阅读以下材料：四个选项中，只有一个能够从材料本身推出。

questions.stem: 结合提示“Read between lines / Stress signals demand. / What a vacancy notice selects for attention”，哪一项真正得到材料的支持？.

options.text: Deadlines are optional there
The employer has no deadlines at all
options.misconception: reverses the direction of the reasoning the passage sets out

options.text: The job is relaxed and slow
The role demands high time management

questions.explanation: The passage gives the controlling distinction: stressing fast pace and tight deadlines implies high time management demands. On that basis "The role demands high time management" is the supported choice. Option A ("Deadlines are optional there") fails because it treats stress as optional; Option B ("The employer has no deadlines at all") fails because it reverses the direction of the reasoning that settles what a vacancy notice selects for attention; Option C ("The job is relaxed and slow") fails because it contradicts the wording.
